title: Privacy Policy | Glossy · Old English Interlinear Glosses
heading: Privacy Policy
description: Effective Date: March 2025 · Last Updated: October 2026
privacySummaryText: Glossy is an offline-first scholarly application. Except for standard Cloudflare edge request logging for network security and content delivery (§3), we do not set tracking cookies, run analytics scripts, or collect user telemetry. Your custom texts and edits remain stored locally in your browser.

privacySections.title: Information We Do Not Collect
bullets: Tracking & Analytics: We do not set marketing cookies, run behavioral analytics scripts, or record user telemetry.

Accounts & Authentication: No account registration is required to read, gloss, or export texts. An optional sign-in is available solely for repository maintainers accessing the TinaCMS content management interface.

privacySections.title: Browser Storage (localStorage)
privacySections.content: To ensure that your work is preserved when refreshing the page or working offline, Glossy stores draft documents and workspace preferences locally in your web browser:
bullets: Local Document Drafts: Stores working drafts and editing snapshots of corpus texts.
Pending Draft Manifest: Maintains an index of uncommitted local edits across sessions.
Active Reader Selection: Remembers your last active text selection for seamless continuation.

privacySections.title: Static Hosting & Edge Delivery
privacySections.content: Glossy is delivered via Cloudflare Pages as a static application. Server access logs are standard HTTP request logs processed at Cloudflare's edge for basic DDoS protection and CDN caching.
bullets: Standard request logs include IP address, request time, user-agent, and requested asset path.
Edge access logs are ephemeral and are not linked to personal user identities.

privacySections.title: Open Source Code & Data Portability
privacySections.content: You maintain complete ownership and control over any text you ingest or gloss in Glossy. You can export your full gloss data at any time via LaTeX gb4e, JSON, or CSV, or wipe all browser-stored drafts by clearing your browser's site data.
bullets: One-click LaTeX gb4e export produces self-contained academic TeX files.
Local drafts can be deleted individually from the home corpus directory.
